name: harvest-field
title: Ogorul cu grâu (secerișul, lângă casa gospodarului)
units: engine units (figure 4.2 tall), three.js Y-up, +Z towards the usual camera

reap-a.note: on the margin facing the wheat (-Z): the reaper stands here; put a `wheat` patch 1.3 in front of him (z - 1.3)

reap-b.note: on the margin facing the wheat (-Z): the reaper stands here; put a `wheat` patch 1.3 in front of him (z - 1.3)

reap-c.note: on the margin facing the wheat (-Z): the reaper stands here; put a `wheat` patch 1.3 in front of him (z - 1.3)

margin-left.note: on the straw margin in front of the field, left

margin-right.note: on the straw margin in front of the field, right

center.note: the middle of the acting area, between the field and the path

road-left.note: on the path, left (walking +X towards the house)

road-mid.note: on the path in the middle

road-right.note: on the path near the house

house.note: in front of the farmer's door, facing out

house-door.note: standing in the doorway, facing out (enter / leave the house)

tree.note: in the shade of the fig tree, facing the field

offstage-left.note: out of frame on the path, left (enter walking +X)

options.reaped: true → the field is cut: stubble and stooks of sheaves instead of the standing wheat

wide.note: the field across the back, the house right, the tree left

edge.note: the reaping place at the field edge

notes: The wheat field fills z < edge(x) ≈ -3; reap on the margin in front of it with the `wheat` prop patches (2.6 wide), the reaper 1.3 in front of the patch facing -Z. The path runs along x at z ≈ 5–7 to the house on the right (door node door:house, anchors house / house-door). Collision: col:house*, col:granaryN, col:tree*, col:palmN, col:bushN, col:donkey.
